import re

CTRL = re.compile(r'^(?P<model>\S.*?) in Slot (?P<slot>\S+)\s*(?P<note>.*?)\s*\(sn: (?P<sn>[^)]+)\)\s*$')
CAGE = re.compile(r'^\s+(?P<name>\S.*?) at Port (?P<port>\S+), Box (?P<box>[^,]+), (?P<status>.+?)\s*$')
PORT = re.compile(r'^\s+Port Name: (?P<port>\S+)\s*$')
ARR = re.compile(r'^\s+Array (?P<array>\S+) \((?P<type>.*?), Unused Space: (?P<unused>.*?)\)\s*$')
UNASS = re.compile(r'^\s+Unassigned\s*$')
LD = re.compile(r'^\s+logicaldrive (?P<id>\S+) \((?P<size>[^,]+), RAID (?P<raid>[^,]+), (?P<status>[^)]+)\)\s*$')
PD = re.compile(r'^\s+physicaldrive (?P<id>\S+) \(port (?P<port>[^:]+):box (?P<box>[^:]+):bay (?P<bay>[^,]+), (?P<type>[^,]+), (?P<size>[^,]+), (?P<status>[^,)]+)(?:, (?P<extra>[^)]+))?\)\s*$')
SEP = re.compile(r'^\s+SEP \(Vendor ID (?P<vendor>.*?), Model (?P<model>.*?)\)\s+(?P<device>\S+)\s+\(WWID: (?P<wwid>[^)]+)\)\s*$')

def parse(lines):
    names = ['controllers', 'drive_cages', 'ports', 'arrays', 'logical_drives', 'physical_drives', 'enclosures']
    b = {}
    for n in names:
        b[n] = {'name': n, 'kind': 'table', 'lines': [], 'records': []}
    skip = []
    ctrl = ''
    arr = ''
    for i, l in enumerate(lines):
        if not l.strip():
            continue
        m = CTRL.match(l)
        if m:
            ctrl = m.group('slot')
            arr = ''
            b['controllers']['lines'].append(i)
            b['controllers']['records'].append({'Model': m.group('model'), 'Slot': m.group('slot'), 'Note': m.group('note').strip(), 'sn': m.group('sn').strip()})
            continue
        m = CAGE.match(l)
        if m:
            b['drive_cages']['lines'].append(i)
            b['drive_cages']['records'].append({'Controller Slot': ctrl, 'Cage': m.group('name'), 'Port': m.group('port'), 'Box': m.group('box').strip(), 'Status': m.group('status')})
            continue
        m = PORT.match(l)
        if m:
            b['ports']['lines'].append(i)
            b['ports']['records'].append({'Controller Slot': ctrl, 'Port Name': m.group('port')})
            continue
        m = ARR.match(l)
        if m:
            arr = m.group('array')
            b['arrays']['lines'].append(i)
            b['arrays']['records'].append({'Controller Slot': ctrl, 'Array': arr, 'Type': m.group('type'), 'Unused Space': re.sub(r'\s+', ' ', m.group('unused').strip())})
            continue
        if UNASS.match(l):
            arr = 'Unassigned'
            skip.append(i)
            continue
        m = LD.match(l)
        if m:
            b['logical_drives']['lines'].append(i)
            b['logical_drives']['records'].append({'Controller Slot': ctrl, 'Array': arr, 'logicaldrive': m.group('id'), 'Size': m.group('size').strip(), 'RAID': m.group('raid').strip(), 'Status': m.group('status').strip()})
            continue
        m = PD.match(l)
        if m:
            b['physical_drives']['lines'].append(i)
            b['physical_drives']['records'].append({'Controller Slot': ctrl, 'Array': arr, 'physicaldrive': m.group('id'), 'port': m.group('port').strip(), 'box': m.group('box').strip(), 'bay': m.group('bay').strip(), 'Type': m.group('type').strip(), 'Size': m.group('size').strip(), 'Status': m.group('status').strip(), 'Extra': (m.group('extra') or '').strip()})
            continue
        m = SEP.match(l)
        if m:
            b['enclosures']['lines'].append(i)
            b['enclosures']['records'].append({'Controller Slot': ctrl, 'Vendor ID': m.group('vendor'), 'Model': m.group('model'), 'Device': m.group('device'), 'WWID': m.group('wwid').strip()})
            continue
    out = [b[n] for n in names if b[n]['records']]
    return {'blocks': out, 'skip': skip}
